Priya’s parents will be helped by this program linking with government schemes and facilities. Also he will be provided
different skill development training where they can earn a good amount of money to run the family. He will be provided
different training to manage during flood time. Her mother will be joined in women livelihood society where she can be
taught to eam money. Priya will be part of child leadership team where she will develop his leadership skills through
games, sports and other activities. Also she will provide training on child protection, child rights and child safety.
